title: APPA: Adaptive Preference Pluralistic Alignment for Fair Federated RLHF of LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning LLMs with pluralistic human preferences, explicitly mentioning 'diverse values, opinions, and social norms' as the core challenge. It benchmarks its approach using the GLOBALQA and OQA datasets, both of which contain questions and respondent groupings specifically categorized by religion and cultural values.
